name: io.github.baktun-studio/linebreak-gate
title: LineBreak Gate & Spec Bridge
description: Serves your approved acceptance criteria over MCP into Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Six tools: list/get/next story, story status, per-story check with the same engine CI runs, and spec/signature status. Git is the transport - no network, no account, works on a bare clone. Nothing in the bridge can edit an approved criterion.
